$comment: The reachable set for a runner slot, enforced by bin/egress-proxy.mjs --mode enforce --deny-private --allowlist container/runner/egress-allow.json. DEFAULT DENY. Seeded from the observe ledger of three real jobs (2026-10-22), then what actions/checkout, actions/setup-node@8207627 and this repository's action.yml fetch at their defaults.
note: A leading dot covers the domain and its subdomains; nothing else is a wildcard. productionresultssaN is listed one account at a time from GitHub's /meta actions_inbound (2026-10-22: 140 accounts), because storage account names are first come, first served and a pattern would admit accounts anybody can create. When GitHub adds an account, an upload to it is refused and the ledger shows it as denied.

allow.why: git fetch for actions/checkout, and release downloads (setup-node's Node build) before they redirect to release-assets
action tarball resolution, setup-node's versions manifest (git/trees and the blob it names), and upload-sarif's code scanning upload
action archives: api.github.com's tarball links redirect here for every `uses:`
dialled by the runner itself in the observed jobs. Exact host, so the package registries beneath it (npm.pkg.github.com and the rest) stay closed

the runner's own services: broker, pipelines*, results-receiver, run-actions*, token (OIDC) and pkg (action packages). GitHub names these per region and adds more, so the domain is the unit; all are in /meta actions_inbound
where github.com release downloads redirect, measured 2026-10-22 on setup-node's node 26 linux-arm64 build; the slot image has no tool cache, so every setup-node job downloads
GitHub's actions_inbound host for release and runner downloads. It serves the same release bytes as release-assets, so it adds no new kind of content
setup-node's fallback when a version is missing from the actions/node-versions manifest: /dist/index.json and the /dist tarballs
npm ci and npm audit in Node jobs on the PATH setup-node builds, and `commitwork deps --audit-gate`, which reads advisories from the registry
action.yml defaults to the `fast` group, whose sast lane runs the image's semgrep with --config p/default, fetched from this registry; without it the lane does not measure
vendor-scan, also in the `fast` group, queries OSV for each vendored bundle it identifies; unreachable, it reports ran:false

deliberatelyAbsent.why: dialled once by the runner itself, not by a step. It is in neither /meta actions nor actions_inbound, no runner 2.338.0 binary names it, so the host comes from the service, and all three observed jobs succeeded without needing anything from it. A job that fails on it shows the host as denied in the ledger.
every Azure customer's storage. Anybody can create an account there, which makes it an upload channel; the accounts above are GitHub's, listed one by one.
nothing measured fetches it: setup-node at the pinned sha reads its manifest through api.github.com and checkout uses git. Add it when a ledger shows it denied.
covers gists and the user content of every repository; the hosts above are listed one by one.
with files.pythonhosted.org, needed only by action.yml's install-tools step, which defaults to false; the image already carries the scanners the default group runs.
with static.crates.io: no observed job and no default step builds Rust.
